NOVEMBER 22ND 1980 - WIMBLEDON - BELGRAVE OPEN 7 / THE BERMAN CUP
Fred Denny, President of the R.W.A.

photos.c: The Walking Section congratulate Joe Coleman following his election to the President's office. L to R; Back row. Carl Lawton, Mike Scamell, John Keown John Newman, Russell Day, John Dunsford. Middle. John Morris, Fred Denny, Richard Dorman, JOE COLEMAN, John Llewellin,Ed. Crossingham, Tom Carter, Ted Stimpson, Kneeling; Graham Seatter, Ron Day, John Hall.

TOP LEFT: Don Bartliff (2) and his rivals are the only ones who can say what the female bystander's comments were! TOP RIGHT:Ken Bailey in the lead at 17 miles. BOTTOM LEFT:Ray Hall leads Dennis Read (the eventual winner) and D. Vale (S.W.C.) in the chase after Bailey. BOTTOM RIGHT:John Morris receives refreshment from Fred Denny, with John Keown alongside. Gerry Cameron follows by bicyle.
